head: b98a0e81df0e3ca7fc59499d9246aa42f03038ab
scope: stage-2 Newton-0 selected live mode3 RHS fixed-input FD, source review only
snapshot_before_each_call: Pristine B,K,U_eval,a, directions, S/Sinv, effective H/mask, actual stage/Newton/rank identifiers, dt and reference U_ref_stage_; tensor value/hash and metadata and meaningful owner/version where stable. Inspect value rather than requiring scratch versions to return after center.

Required captured fixed subset: p_base, th_base, mu_base, ph_base, c1h,c2h,c1f,c2f, six map factors, cqu,cqv,cqw,zx,zy. Check reference, topology/BC/packed condition, mode, no full halo, omega reference update off, dtype/device, no reuse, options and stage dt; source and executable identity, AD and fallback counters. Check map epoch/cache freshness and native scalar/geometry inputs beyond f.context; that list itself is not exhaustive.

Gate the base-state pressure branch (p_base,th_base,ph_base defined/nonempty plus valid mu_base) and actual stage2 pressure EOS/V primary capture, project_native nonempty, not failed/duplicate and same live Tile lifetime/profile, for Q. Do not assume the capture exists for a different selected stage or unarmed build.

conditional_recomputed_exclusions.p_pert_work: Label is already p_pert_work, so A10 _work exclusion covers it. In valid base-state branch calc_p_rho overwrites p_pert_ at 20533–20539 before later member reads; result depends on perturbed Y and may rebind. Fail/gate unsupported branch rather than assume old pressure irrelevant.
conditional_recomputed_exclusions.ru_tend rv_tend rw_tend t_tend mu_tend p: Both allocation branches reset them to zeros at 16171–16244 before current RHS use; these change/rebind; qv setup depends on grid moisture, gate dry case.
conditional_recomputed_exclusions.dpx_work cqw_at_w_work: Relevant branches initialize or zero before use, 20694–20699 and 21835–21840. Owner/versions can change.
conditional_recomputed_exclusions.cqu_at_u_work cqv_at_v_work: fill_(1) then interpolate before use, 20912 onward and 21322 onward; legitimate in-place version increments.
conditional_recomputed_exclusions.ru_adv_z_work rv_adv_z_work rw_adv_z_wor: Inspected member references in computeUnifiedRHS are stores of locally computed results (with branch-dependent absence); not value invariants. This does not prove all transitive consumers or continuation side effects absent.

caveats: Do not exclude arbitrary _work by name as proof: for each actively used branch, establish overwrite-before-read or treat its prior value as unproven mathematical input; full cache/observer/backend state is not covered. Map/base tensors can be rebound by refresh/alignment at 16425–16562: gate valid stable epochs/device/dtype and compare input values; an unexpected rebind or mismatch is ineligible rather than silently accepted.

A centered baseline reevaluation is not state restore and does not make work tensor owner/version match its pre-perturbation state. Compare actual baseline output and repeat plus/minus order to detect drift; this gives sample evidence, not proof of context independence. Terminal stop avoids claiming continuation safety.

A10 f.context Handle.unchanged compares owner/version; its hash is computed for unchanged subset and excludes names containing _work plus tendency list. It is not an immutable cloned context and not a complete fingerprint.
No source edits, test, build, run or RK3 comparison.
